description: Read your workspace settings: company name, address, email, phone, website and description, tax id, default currency, payment terms, invoice prefix and footer, whether tax is on, the tax registrations and the sales playbook. Model keys are never shown. Needs a Last Price credential with workspace settings read scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.
name: get_workspace_settings
